method: static source review; no vendor JavaScript execution
interpretation: Export serializes current deviceData, not necessarily the saved profile named in filename.
getDeviceData includes deviceConfig.mouseConfig with cidMid and DPI fields.
getMouseFunction exports raw maxDpi count and currentDpi index; reportRate is the Ma enum 0..6.
_getMouseDpiConfig emits logical XY values with usesLogical true.
Only active stages and polling are converted; all other source fields are excluded and preview states this explicitly.
limits: Envelope Base64 library traced separately in 2026-10-28-atk-bin-envelope-source.json.
Fixtures are independently generated from source shape, not hardware captures or a user OEM export.
No claim of old raw-DPI file compatibility, complete OEM import or full model acceptance.
